title: Herbal Fluffini Muffin Tadka
description: A unique dessert recipe combining herbal flavors with fluffini and muffin textures, topped with a tadka crunch.
instructions: Mix the flour, herbal tea leaves, fluffini powder, granulated sugar, and muffin mix in a large bowl.
Whisk the eggs and milk together in a separate bowl.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until combined.
Heat the vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the tadka spice mix and with spice blend to the oil and stir.
Pour the batter into a greased muffin tin.
Drizzle the tadka oil mixture over the muffins.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
